title: viola selkirkii f. laciniata
intro: Viola selkirkii f. laciniata, commonly known as the Fragrant Pansy or Western Yellow Viola, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the genus Viola. This plant is prized for its fragrant, yellow flowers and is used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, reduce stress, and alleviate anxiety. The health benefits of Viola selkirkii f. laciniata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedative and antispasmodic effects.
